explanation.en: Hold the electric file straight against the end of the acrylic nail. It cuts across the end instead of shaping the top.
explanation.zh: 把电动磨甲机垂直对准丙烯酸甲的前端。这样会横向磨短前端，而不是打磨甲面形状。

lockPoint.en: 90 degrees = hold the file straight to the nail end.
lockPoint.zh: 90 度 = 磨甲机垂直对准指甲前端。

explanation.en: Disinfection means using a chemical to kill most germs on a hard surface after the surface has been cleaned.
explanation.zh: disinfection（消毒）是指先把坚硬表面清洁干净，再用化学消毒剂杀死上面的大多数细菌。

lockPoint.en: clean the hard surface first; disinfect it second.
lockPoint.zh: 先清洁坚硬表面，再进行消毒。

explanation.en: An infection starts when germs that cause illness get inside body tissue and live or grow there.
explanation.zh: 当会使人生病的细菌进入人体组织，并在里面生存或生长时，就形成 infection（感染）。

lockPoint.en: infection = harmful germs living inside body tissue.
lockPoint.zh: infection = 有害细菌进入人体组织并在里面生存。

explanation.en: Sterilization kills every kind of germ. Disinfection kills most germs, but it does not kill every kind.
explanation.zh: sterilization（灭菌）能杀死所有种类的微生物；disinfection（消毒）只能杀死大多数微生物，不能杀死全部。

lockPoint.en: sterilization = kills all germs; disinfection = kills most.
lockPoint.zh: sterilization = 杀死全部微生物；disinfection = 杀死大多数微生物。

explanation.en: The hyponychium is living skin under the nail tip. It helps stop germs from reaching the skin below the nail.
explanation.zh: hyponychium（甲下皮）是指甲前端下方的活皮肤。它帮助阻止细菌进入指甲下面的皮肤。

lockPoint.en: hyponychium = skin under the nail tip.
lockPoint.zh: hyponychium = 指甲前端下方的皮肤。

explanation.en: The matrix makes new cells that grow into the nail plate. It sits under the skin at the base of the nail.
explanation.zh: matrix（甲母质）产生新细胞，这些细胞长成甲板。甲母质位于指甲根部的皮肤下面。

lockPoint.en: matrix = the area that grows the nail plate.
lockPoint.zh: matrix = 让甲板生长的部位。

explanation.en: A pedicure cares for natural toenails and the skin of the feet. The other services add product to make a new nail layer.
explanation.zh: pedicure（足部美甲护理）护理天然脚趾甲和足部皮肤。其他服务都会添加产品，做出新的甲面层。

lockPoint.en: pedicure = natural toenail and foot care.
lockPoint.zh: pedicure = 天然脚趾甲和足部护理。

explanation.en: Primer helps the nail product stick to the natural nail. This helps stop the product from lifting.
explanation.zh: primer（底剂）帮助美甲产品黏在天然指甲上，从而减少产品翘起。

lockPoint.en: primer = helps nail product stick.
lockPoint.zh: primer = 帮助美甲产品黏牢。

explanation.en: Acetone is a solvent. A solvent is a liquid that can soften and remove some nail products.
explanation.zh: acetone（丙酮）是一种 solvent（溶剂）。溶剂是可以软化并卸除某些美甲产品的液体。

lockPoint.en: acetone = liquid that removes some nail products.
lockPoint.zh: acetone = 可卸除某些美甲产品的液体。

explanation.en: The ulna is the arm bone on the little-finger side. The radius is on the thumb side.
explanation.zh: ulna（尺骨）是手臂靠小指一侧的骨；radius（桡骨）在靠拇指的一侧。

lockPoint.en: ulna = little-finger side; radius = thumb side.
lockPoint.zh: ulna = 小指侧；radius = 拇指侧。

authorityRefs.section: Anatomy - Bones of the Arms and Hands

explanation.en: Tapotement uses quick taps on the skin. Effleurage moves the hands slowly and smoothly instead.
explanation.zh: tapotement（叩击法）是在皮肤上快速轻拍；effleurage（轻抚法）则让双手缓慢、平滑地移动。

lockPoint.en: tapotement = quick taps; effleurage = slow, smooth hand movement.
lockPoint.zh: tapotement = 快速轻拍；effleurage = 双手缓慢、平滑地移动。

explanation.en: Ask about allergies before the service. This helps you avoid products that may hurt the client.
explanation.zh: 服务前要询问顾客是否过敏，这样可以避开可能伤害顾客的产品。

lockPoint.en: ask about allergies before choosing products.
lockPoint.zh: 选择产品前，先询问过敏情况。

explanation.en: Healthy, unbroken skin helps keep outside germs from entering the body. A cut gives germs a way in.
explanation.zh: 健康、没有破损的 skin（皮肤）能阻止外界细菌进入身体；伤口会给细菌留下入口。

lockPoint.en: unbroken skin helps keep germs out.
lockPoint.zh: 没有破损的皮肤可帮助阻挡细菌。

authorityRefs.section: Skin Structure - Functions of the Skin

explanation.en: Onychia means the nail's growth area is sore and swollen. Infection or injury can cause it.
explanation.zh: onychia（甲母质炎）是指甲生长部位疼痛、肿胀，可能由感染或受伤引起。

lockPoint.en: onychia = a sore, swollen nail growth area.
lockPoint.zh: onychia = 指甲生长部位疼痛、肿胀。

explanation.en: MMA makes very hard nails that are difficult to remove. Removing them can hurt the natural nail, so the FDA says not to use MMA.
explanation.zh: MMA 会做出非常坚硬、难以卸除的美甲，卸除时可能伤害天然指甲，因此 FDA 要求不要使用 MMA。

lockPoint.en: MMA monomer = do not use for nail services.
lockPoint.zh: MMA 单体液 = 不可用于美甲服务。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Product Chemistry - Methyl Methacrylate Monomer

explanation.en: Electric filing puts small pieces of dust into the air. A mask that fits well helps keep this dust out of your mouth and nose.
explanation.zh: 电动磨甲会让细小粉尘进入空气。贴合良好的口罩可帮助阻止粉尘进入口鼻。

lockPoint.en: electric file dust = wear a mask that fits well.
lockPoint.zh: 电动磨甲粉尘 = 戴贴合良好的口罩。

explanation.en: Oil, water, dust, or dead skin left on the nail can stop a tip from sticking. If that material lifts, the tip lifts too.
explanation.zh: 甲面残留的油、水、粉尘或死皮会让甲片黏不牢；这些残留物一旦翘起，甲片也会翘起。

lockPoint.en: clean, dry nail = the tip sticks better.
lockPoint.zh: 指甲清洁、干燥 = 甲片黏得更牢。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Tips - Dry Manicure or Nail Preparation

explanation.en: Cross-linking joins polymer chains to each other. Joining the chains makes the nail product stronger and harder to remove.
explanation.zh: cross-linking（交联）把聚合物链互相连接。连接这些链会让美甲产品更坚固，也更难卸除。

lockPoint.en: cross-linking = polymer chains joined for strength.
lockPoint.zh: cross-linking = 连接聚合物链，使产品更坚固。

authorityRefs.section: Nail Product Chemistry - Cross-Linking Polymer Chains

explanation.en: An MSDS was the older safety sheet for a product. It listed dangerous ingredients and explained how to use, store, and handle the product safely.
explanation.zh: MSDS 是过去使用的产品安全资料表。它列出危险成分，并说明怎样安全使用、存放和处理该产品。

lockPoint.en: MSDS/SDS = product dangers plus safe handling.
lockPoint.zh: MSDS/SDS = 产品危险信息和安全处理方法。

authorityRefs.section: Chemistry and Chemical Safety - Interpret Safety Data Sheets

explanation.en: Soap and running water remove dirt and germs from the hands. This helps stop germs from moving from one person to another.
explanation.zh: 肥皂和流动水能洗掉手上的污垢和细菌，帮助阻止细菌从一个人传到另一个人。

lockPoint.en: wash hands before and after each client.
lockPoint.zh: 每位客户服务前后都要洗手。

explanation.en: Used products and dust can remain anywhere on the work table. Clean and disinfect the whole table before the next client.
explanation.zh: 使用过的产品和粉尘可能留在工作台的任何位置。下一位客户到来前，要清洁并消毒整个工作台。

lockPoint.en: after each client: clean and disinfect the whole table.
lockPoint.zh: 每位客户之后：清洁并消毒整个工作台。

authorityRefs.section: Manicuring - The Nail Technology Work Table

explanation.en: Changing the towels removes used material. Disinfecting the table kills most germs left on its hard surface.
explanation.zh: 更换毛巾可以移走用过的材料；消毒工作台可以杀死坚硬表面上残留的大多数细菌。

lockPoint.en: every client = clean towels plus a disinfected table.
lockPoint.zh: 每位客户 = 干净毛巾和已消毒的工作台。

authorityRefs.section: Manicuring - The Nail Technology Work Table

explanation.en: Fingers can carry germs into the cream. A clean spatula removes one amount without touching the product that remains.
explanation.zh: 手指可能把细菌带进面霜。用干净的小刮勺取出一次用量，不会碰到容器中剩余的产品。

lockPoint.en: cream in a tub = use a clean spatula.
lockPoint.zh: 罐装面霜 = 用干净的小刮勺取用。

explanation.en: An MSDS was the older name for an SDS. This sheet tells workers about product dangers and safe handling.
explanation.zh: MSDS 是 SDS 过去的名称。这份资料表告诉工作人员产品有哪些危险，以及怎样安全处理。

lockPoint.en: MSDS/SDS = product safety instructions.
lockPoint.zh: MSDS/SDS = 产品安全说明。

authorityRefs.section: Chemistry and Chemical Safety - Interpret Safety Data Sheets

explanation.en: A safety sheet only helps when its information is current and workers can reach it quickly during an emergency.
explanation.zh: 安全资料表必须内容最新，而且工作人员在紧急情况下能马上拿到，才真正有用。

lockPoint.en: safety sheet = current and easy to reach.
lockPoint.zh: 安全资料表 = 内容最新，随时可取。

authorityRefs.section: Chemistry and Chemical Safety - Interpret Safety Data Sheets

explanation.en: Used tools may carry dirt and germs. Clean them first, then disinfect them before they are used again.
explanation.zh: 用过的工具可能带有污垢和细菌。再次使用前，要先清洁，再消毒。

lockPoint.en: used tools: clean first, disinfect second.
lockPoint.zh: 用过的工具：先清洁，再消毒。

explanation.en: OSHA protects workers. It requires employers to keep safety sheets for dangerous workplace products.
explanation.zh: OSHA（美国职业安全与健康管理局）保护工作人员，并要求雇主保存工作场所危险产品的安全资料表。

lockPoint.en: OSHA = worker safety and SDS rules.
lockPoint.zh: OSHA = 工作人员安全和 SDS 规定。

authorityRefs.section: Chemistry and Chemical Safety - Interpret Safety Data Sheets

explanation.en: Each disinfectant needs its own amount of water and wet time. The product label gives the correct directions.
explanation.zh: 每种消毒剂需要的加水量和保持湿润时间不同。产品标签会给出正确的使用说明。

lockPoint.en: mixing and wet time = follow the label.
lockPoint.zh: 加水量和湿润时间 = 按标签说明。

explanation.en: Each client can leave germs in the foot basin or on tools. Cleaning and disinfecting after every client stops those germs from reaching the next client.
explanation.zh: 每位客户都可能在足浴盆或工具上留下细菌。每位客户之后进行清洁和消毒，可防止细菌传给下一位客户。

lockPoint.en: foot basin and tools: disinfect after every client.
lockPoint.zh: 足浴盆和工具：每位客户之后都要消毒。

authorityRefs.section: Pedicuring - Cleaning and Disinfecting Foot Spas

explanation.en: The manufacturer must provide the product's SDS. It has the exact safety information for that product.
explanation.zh: 产品制造商必须提供该产品的 SDS。表中有这项产品的具体安全信息。

lockPoint.en: get the SDS from the product manufacturer.
lockPoint.zh: 向产品制造商索取 SDS。

authorityRefs.section: Chemistry and Chemical Safety - Interpret Safety Data Sheets

explanation.en: Workers may need an SDS during normal use or an emergency. Keeping it at work makes the safety information easy to reach.
explanation.zh: 工作人员在日常使用或紧急情况下都可能需要 SDS。把它保存在工作场所，才能随时查到安全信息。

lockPoint.en: SDS = keep it at the workplace.
lockPoint.zh: SDS = 保存在工作场所。

authorityRefs.section: Chemistry and Chemical Safety - Interpret Safety Data Sheets

explanation.en: Oil and dirt can cover germs and block the disinfectant. Clean the tool first so the disinfectant can touch its surface.
explanation.zh: 油和污垢可能盖住细菌，挡住消毒剂。先清洁工具，消毒剂才能接触工具表面。

lockPoint.en: dirty tool: clean first, disinfect second.
lockPoint.zh: 脏工具：先清洁，再消毒。

explanation.en: Bacterial spores are a very hard-to-kill form of bacteria. Salon disinfectants do not kill them.
explanation.zh: bacterial spores（细菌芽孢）是非常难杀死的一种细菌形态。沙龙消毒剂不能杀死它们。

lockPoint.en: disinfectant kills most germs, not bacterial spores.
lockPoint.zh: 消毒剂能杀死大多数细菌，但不能杀死细菌芽孢。

explanation.en: Cleaning removes visible dirt and many germs. It prepares the item for the stronger second step: disinfection.
explanation.zh: 清洁能去掉看得见的污垢和许多细菌，并为下一步消毒做好准备。

lockPoint.en: level 1 = cleaning; level 2 = disinfection.
lockPoint.zh: 第一级 = 清洁；第二级 = 消毒。

explanation.en: Turning each glove inside out keeps the dirty outside away from bare skin. It also holds both used gloves together for disposal.
explanation.zh: 逐只把手套由内向外翻，可以避免脏的外侧碰到裸露皮肤，也能把两只用过的手套包在一起丢弃。

lockPoint.en: remove gloves inside out; touch only the clean side.
lockPoint.zh: 脱手套时由内向外翻，只碰干净的一面。

explanation.en: Clean, dry tools need a closed place after sterilization. The cover protects them from new dirt and germs before use.
explanation.zh: 工具灭菌并干燥后，需要放在封闭处。盖子能防止工具在使用前再次沾上污垢和细菌。

lockPoint.en: treated tools = clean, dry, closed storage.
lockPoint.zh: 处理后的工具 = 清洁、干燥、封闭存放。

explanation.en: Disinfectants need the correct wet time to work. That time differs by product, so follow the maker's directions.
explanation.zh: 消毒剂必须保持正确的湿润时间才能起作用。不同产品需要的时间不同，所以要按制造商说明操作。

lockPoint.en: pedicure basin wet time = follow product directions.
lockPoint.zh: 足浴盆消毒时间 = 按产品说明。

authorityRefs.section: Pedicuring - Cleaning and Disinfecting Basic Foot Basins or Tubs

explanation.en: Scrubbing loosens dirt and product left in the basin. Disinfectant cannot work well until that material is removed.
explanation.zh: 刷洗能除去足浴盆里残留的污垢和产品。先清除这些东西，消毒剂才能充分接触盆面。

lockPoint.en: scrub the basin first; disinfect it second.
lockPoint.zh: 先刷洗足浴盆，再消毒。

authorityRefs.section: Pedicuring - Cleaning and Disinfecting Foot Spas

explanation.en: Infection control breaks the path germs use to move between people. It protects both the client and the worker.
explanation.zh: infection control（感染控制）能切断细菌在人与人之间传播的途径，保护客户和工作人员。

lockPoint.en: infection control = stop germs from spreading.
lockPoint.zh: infection control = 阻止细菌传播。

explanation.en: Disinfection uses a chemical to kill most harmful germs on a cleaned hard surface. It does not kill every kind.
explanation.zh: disinfection（消毒）是在清洁后的坚硬表面使用化学消毒剂，杀死大多数有害细菌，但不能杀死全部。

lockPoint.en: disinfection = kills most germs, not all.
lockPoint.zh: disinfection = 杀死大多数细菌，不是全部。

explanation.en: Broken skin gives blood or body fluid a way into the body. Work contact like this is an exposure incident and needs the safety procedure.
explanation.zh: 破损皮肤会让血液或体液有机会进入身体。工作中发生这种接触就是 exposure incident（暴露事件），必须执行安全处理步骤。

lockPoint.en: blood plus broken skin at work = exposure incident.
lockPoint.zh: 工作中血液接触破损皮肤 = 暴露事件。

explanation.en: A tool that falls on the floor may pick up germs. Replace it, or clean and disinfect it before continuing.
explanation.zh: 工具掉到地上可能沾上细菌。应立即换一件工具，或在继续服务前清洁并消毒掉落的工具。

lockPoint.en: dropped tool = replace it or disinfect before reuse.
lockPoint.zh: 工具掉地 = 更换，或消毒后再用。

authorityRefs.section: Infection Control - Disinfecting Implements During a Service

explanation.en: An unused appliance can still cause heat, shock, or fire while plugged in. Unplug it by holding the plug, not the cord.
explanation.zh: 电器即使没有使用，插着电也可能引起过热、触电或火灾。拔插头时要握住插头，不要拉电线。

lockPoint.en: unused appliance = unplug it by the plug.
lockPoint.zh: 不用的电器 = 握住插头拔下。

authorityRefs.section: Electricity and Electrical Safety - Electrical Equipment Safety

explanation.en: Gloves can carry germs from one client to another. Use a new pair for every client and wash your hands when changing them.
explanation.zh: 手套可能把细菌从一位客户带给另一位。每位客户都要换一副新手套，更换时也要洗手。

lockPoint.en: every client = new gloves.
lockPoint.zh: 每位客户 = 一副新手套。

explanation.en: Pus forms while the body fights an infection. Seeing pus is a sign of a bacterial infection.
explanation.zh: 身体对抗感染时可能形成脓。看到脓，说明可能有细菌感染。

lockPoint.en: pus = sign of bacterial infection.
lockPoint.zh: 脓 = 细菌感染的迹象。

explanation.en: Cleaning removes visible dirt and many germs. Disinfectant cannot reach the surface well until the dirt is gone.
explanation.zh: 清洁能去掉看得见的污垢和许多细菌。先除去污垢，消毒剂才能充分接触表面。

lockPoint.en: step 1 = clean away dirt.
lockPoint.zh: 第一步 = 清除污垢。

explanation.en: After cleaning removes dirt, disinfecting kills most harmful germs left on the hard surface.
explanation.zh: 清洁去掉污垢后，再进行消毒，杀死坚硬表面上剩余的大多数有害细菌。

lockPoint.en: step 2 = disinfect the cleaned surface.
lockPoint.zh: 第二步 = 消毒已清洁的表面。

explanation.en: An unmarked container can be mistaken for another product. Label every container so workers know what is inside and how to use it.
explanation.zh: 没有标签的容器可能被误认成另一种产品。每个容器都要贴标签，让工作人员知道里面是什么以及怎样使用。

lockPoint.en: every chemical container needs a clear label.
lockPoint.zh: 每个化学品容器都需要清楚的标签。

explanation.en: Standard Precautions treat all blood and body fluids as able to spread illness. Workers use the same safety steps with every client.
explanation.zh: Standard Precautions（标准预防措施）把所有血液和体液都视为可能传播疾病，因此对每位客户都采用相同的安全步骤。

lockPoint.en: Standard Precautions = treat all blood as unsafe.
lockPoint.zh: Standard Precautions = 把所有血液都视为有感染风险。
